replication.target_description: Detroit public-initiated 2019 police calls: descriptive scale/composition analysis replicating and extending Ratcliffe and Lum. Broad study identified; unique row-specific statistic/test unresolved.

es.quote:
Just 44% of emergency calls for service related to crime incidents.
These crime incidents consume 51% of time on the scene throughout the year. The remainder
of time on scene is spent dealing with traffic duties (16%), quality of life incidents (15%),
public and mental health (7%), community issues (5%), and proactive policing (4%).

p.location: pp. 154–160, methods and all results; Tables 7.1–7.2, Figures 7.1–7.4
p.quote:
Summary statistics describe the overall composition of demand according to the six demand-
    type classifications. This includes call frequency counts, a proportional breakdown of call
    counts, and a proportional breakdown of police time.
